title: Return to previously visited tab after closing active tab
outcome: Track a most-recently-used tab history per workspace pane. When the active tab is closed, select the most recently visited surviving tab in that pane; retain the existing adjacent-tab fallback when no history entry survives. Add focused tests for visit order, stale history entries, inactive-tab closure, and pane-local isolation.
